content.simple_explanation: To learn Bravehearts — A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers, first understand the main idea, then identify supporting evidence/examples or steps, and finally apply the idea.
key_points: Bravehearts Unit 5 BRAVEHEARTS A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers Let us do these activities before we read.
I Homage means ‘something that is said or done to show respect publicly for someone’.
II Work in pairs to complete the table by writing any three ways in which we can celebrate the victories and honour the sacrifices of the soldiers.
